_comment: Shadow-oracle request material for busbar 1.5.5's admin API: one entry per operationId of fixtures/openapi-1.5.5.json (66 operations / 49 paths).

Sources: openapi-1.5.5.json (schemas, x-busbar-required-scope, If-Match params), docs/design/inventory/1.5.5-routes-admin.md (ADM-001..066), docs/design/inventory/1.5.5-config.md section 2 (config shapes), testing/shadow-oracle/oracle-config.sh (what exists at record time).

Auth: every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <ORACLE_ADMIN_TOKEN>` (the admin-tokens provider; x-admin-token is the equivalent header). Bodies are sent with Content-Type: application/json where `body` is non-null.

Placeholders substituted by the recorder: {KEY_OK} {KEY_BROKE} {KEY_NOSCOPE} (minted key ids), {TMP} (a writable temp dir), {WORK} (the oracle work dir holding signing.key), {LISTEN_ADDR} / {ADMIN_LISTEN_ADDR} (the oracle's `127.0.0.1:<port>` listen strings), {MOCK_URL} (`http://127.0.0.1:<mock_port>`). {GROUP} {HOOK} {EXPORT} {IDP} {PLUGIN_FILE} {SECTION} {V} are resolved to concrete names here (oracle-added / none / oracle-log,metrics / oracle-idp2,admin-tokens / none / root / 0).

Epochs: every op with mutating:false is recorded first (any order); ops in `order` run in the LAST epoch in exactly that sequence (create -> update -> delete; settings write -> overlay reset; key rotate/revoke/delete last because they kill the data-plane principals); `restart_epoch` runs alone at the very end and ends the process.

`ok: null` ops are recorded only through their bad_body / not_found probes: 1.5.5 cannot register a hook without a `kind: hook` plugin (config inventory CFG-220), and the plugin install/inspect/rollback/remove/schema ops need a published signed tarball. These are listed in `needs_fixture`.

Probes: `bad_body` is sent with the ok path (or the not_found path when ok is null) and expects 400; `not_found` is sent with no body and expects the listed status (upsert PUTs return 200 and CREATE the name; DeleteOverlaySection/limits returns 400 because `limits` is not a 1.5.5 overlay section). `if_match: true` ops are additionally replayed with a stale `If-Match: "0"` expecting 409 version_conflict and with `If-Match: garbage` expecting 400. `idempotent: true` ops are replayed with the same Idempotency-Key expecting the identical first response.

Rate classes: Config-class mutations (/config/*, /admin-auth, /overlay/*, /plugins/reload, /plugins/rollback, /restart, /identity-providers/*, /export/*) share ONE 10-per-minute window per principal, including the If-Match/bad_body probes; the recorder must pace them or it will record 429 rate_limited with Retry-After: 60.
Volatile response fields to normalise before diffing: audit seq/ts/hash, config version numbers/ETag, usage as_of/window, minted key ids/tokens, info build fields, openapi info.version.

GetAdminAuth.notes: 200 AdminAuthView (the ordered admin chain); ETag carries the config version.

PutAdminAuth.notes: 200 AdminAuthPutView; body is the oracle's existing chain so nothing changes. Traps: removing the caller's own provider is 400 Cond::LockoutSelf; an unknown module is 400; stale If-Match 409 version_conflict; rate class Config (10/min).

GetAudit.notes: 200 AuditPageView {items,next_cursor}, newest first. A malformed cursor is 400 invalid_request (Cond::MalformedCursor). Body diff is expected to vary by seq/ts/hash; the recorder should normalise those fields.

PostAuthCacheFlush.notes: 200 CacheFlushView; `{}` (or no body) flushes every partition. FlushCacheReq is NOT deny_unknown_fields, so only a wrong-typed `module` is 400; an unknown extra key is accepted.

PostConfigApply.notes: 200 ConfigApplyView; body.config is the oracle's own config.yaml deploy block with limits.request_body_max_bytes pinned to the 32 MiB default (a no-op-equivalent change), body.providers is providers.yaml; `config` is required so bad_body omits it. Placeholders {LISTEN_ADDR} {ADMIN_LISTEN_ADDR} {WORK} {MOCK_URL} must be substituted. Stale If-Match 409 version_conflict, malformed If-Match 400, invalid config 400 'nothing changed'. Rate class Config (10/min): budget the whole mutating epoch under that ceiling.

GetConfigDiff.notes: 200 ConfigDiffView (hook-surface diff between two retained versions). `from` and `to` are REQUIRED integers (missing ⇒ 400); an unknown version ⇒ 404. Version 0 is the boot snapshot re-seeded at every start.

PostConfigReload.notes: 200 ConfigReloadView; re-reads the on-disk config.yaml/providers.yaml and swaps. No body. Rate class Config.

PostConfigRollback.notes: 200 ConfigRollbackView; restores version 0's hook surface as a NEW version. No path param, but an unknown `version` in the body is 404 not_found (e.g. {"version": 999999}). Stale If-Match 409, malformed If-Match 400.

PutConfigSettings.notes: 200 ConfigSettingsView; durable by default (overlay `root`); a locked config refuses with 400. Every top-level key must be a known settings section (unknown ⇒ 400); `persist` is boolean-validated but ignored. Stale If-Match 409 version_conflict. Some fields are restart-to-apply (view carries the flag).

PostConfigValidate.notes: 200 ConfigValidateView; pure validation, read-only scope (carved out of the Config rate class into Crud). Same body as PostConfigApply. Invalid config still returns 200 with the diagnostics in the view; a malformed body / missing `config` is 400.

GetConfigVersions.notes: 200 ConfigVersionPageView {items,next_cursor}, newest first (VERSIONS_LIMIT_DEFAULT 100). ts/principal vary; normalise.

GetConfigVersionsV.notes: 200 ConfigVersionDetailView for the boot snapshot (v=0). Unknown version 404; a non-numeric segment is 400 (Cond::NonNumericPath), e.g. /config/versions/abc.

GetExport.notes: 200 Page_NamedDefView listing the oracle's single `metrics` (prometheus) instance; settings are served as keys / redacted.

DeleteExportName.notes: 204 no content; deletes the `oracle-log` instance created by PutExportName earlier in the epoch. Deleting a base-defined (config.yaml) instance such as `metrics` is 409 conflict (Cond::BaseDefined); still-referenced ⇒ 409. Stale If-Match 409 version_conflict.

GetExportName.notes: 200 NamedDefView for the base-defined `metrics` prometheus instance.

PutExportName.notes: 200 NamedDefView (upsert: PUT on an unknown name CREATES it, so there is no 404 on this op — the not_found probe is expected to return 200 and create `does-not-exist`; skip it or delete afterwards). ExportDefCfg is deny_unknown_fields ⇒ bad_body's `bogus` is 400. `request-log-file` needs settings.path; a second `prometheus`/`otlp` instance is refused. Stale If-Match 409 version_conflict.

PatchExportNameSettings.notes: 200 NamedDefView; `settings` is REPLACED wholesale (never deep-merged) so `path` must be resent. Per-module settings are deny_unknown_fields (a typo inside is 400). Stale If-Match 409.

PostGroups.notes: Creates the NEW group `oracle-added`. Inventory ADM-022: handler returns 200 GroupView although the spec also declares 201 — record whichever 1.5.5 emits. Re-creating an existing name is 409 conflict; a base-defined name is 409 (Cond::BaseDefined); a limit amount of 0 or an unknown metric is 400 (Cond::InvalidTree/InvalidConfig). `config` is required ⇒ bad_body 400.

DeleteGroupsName.notes: 204 no content. A group with bound keys is 409 (Cond::BoundKeys); a group that is still a parent is 409 (Cond::StillParent); base-defined (`oracle`, `broke`) is 409. Must run AFTER PutGroupsName/PatchGroupsName.

PatchGroupsName.notes: 200 GroupView; `limits` REPLACES the whole list. Body is deny_unknown_fields (additionalProperties:false) ⇒ `bogus` 400. Patching a base-defined group is 409 (Cond::BaseDefined). Stale If-Match 409.

PutGroupsName.notes: 200 GroupView (replace). `config` is required ⇒ bad_body 400. Unlike the named-map PUTs this is NOT an upsert: unknown name is 404. Base-defined 409. Stale If-Match 409.

GetGroupsNameUsage.notes: 200 GroupUsageView (metering read for `oracle`; totals depend on the data-plane epochs recorded before it).

GetHooks.notes: 200 Page_HookView — empty on the oracle config (no hooks: block).

PostHooks.notes: ok: null — 1.5.5 `hooks.<h>.module` must name a loaded `kind: hook` plugin by signed-manifest name/alias (CFG-220); the compiled-in `weighted`/`first` words are POOL strategies, not hook modules, so no plugin-free body can be registered. needs plugin fixture. `config` is required ⇒ bad_body 400. Base-defined / grant-change ⇒ 409; a hook whose plugin never acks ⇒ Cond::HookNoAck. Stale If-Match 409.

DeleteHooksName.notes: ok: null — no hook exists on the oracle config; needs plugin fixture. Unknown name 404; base-defined 409; stale If-Match 409.

GetHooksName.notes: ok: null — no hook exists on the oracle config (needs plugin fixture); only the 404 is recordable.

PutHooksName.notes: ok: null — 1.5.5 `hooks.<h>.module` must name a loaded `kind: hook` plugin by signed-manifest name/alias (CFG-220); the compiled-in `weighted`/`first` words are POOL strategies, not hook modules, so no plugin-free body can be registered. needs plugin fixture. `config` is required ⇒ bad_body 400. Not an upsert: unknown name 404.

GetHooksNameHealth.notes: ok: null — no hook exists on the oracle config (needs plugin fixture); only the 404 is recordable.

GetHooksNameSchema.notes: ok: null — no hook exists on the oracle config (needs plugin fixture); only the 404 is recordable.

PatchHooksNameSettings.notes: ok: null — needs plugin fixture. `settings` is REPLACED and pushed to the plugin commit-on-ack (Cond::SettingsPush on failure). Stale If-Match 409.

GetHooksNameStatus.notes: ok: null — no hook exists on the oracle config (needs plugin fixture); only the 404 is recordable.

DeleteIdentityProvidersName.notes: 204; deletes `oracle-idp2` created earlier in the epoch. Deleting the base-defined `admin-tokens` (also the caller's own chain member) is 409 BaseDefined/StillReferenced. Stale If-Match 409.

PutIdentityProvidersName.notes: 200 NamedDefView; creates a second admin-tokens provider `oracle-idp2` (an unreferenced definition is legal). Upsert: an unknown name CREATES it, so the not_found probe returns 200 (skip or delete afterwards). bad_body: `token:` on a module other than admin-tokens is refused (CFG-212) ⇒ 400; unknown keys are 400 (deny_unknown_fields); unknown module 400 Cond::UnknownModule. Stale If-Match 409.

PatchIdentityProvidersNameSettings.notes: 200 NamedDefView; `settings` replaced wholesale (opaque to busbar for admin-tokens). Stale If-Match 409.

GetInfo.notes: 200 InfoView {BuildInfo, TopologyInfo,...}; version/build fields differ 1.5.5 vs 1.6.0 by design — normalise.

GetKeys.notes: 200 KeyPageView {items,next_cursor}; metadata only, never secrets. Filters enabled/prefix/group/include=tombstoned; bad value 400.

PostKeys.notes: 201 CreatedKeyView (secret shown once). Idempotency-Key keyed (actor, header), TTL 600 s: the replay returns the SAME 201 body verbatim with no marker header; a concurrent same-key request is 409 conflict 'a request with this Idempotency-Key is already in flight'. CreateKeyReq is deny_unknown_fields so the removed 1.4.x `rpm_limit` is 400; unknown `group` without `parent` is 400. Token/id in the body are per-run — normalise.

DeleteKeysId.notes: 204; tombstones {KEY_NOSCOPE} (revoke-AND-forget). Run LAST among key ops. An over-long id is 400.

PatchKeysId.notes: 200 KeyView; `enabled: true` is a no-op-equivalent on {KEY_OK}. `group` is three-state (absent/null/value); rebind to a missing group is 400 Cond::RebindTargetMissing. UpdateKeyReq is deny_unknown_fields ⇒ `name` is 400. Stale If-Match 409.

PostKeysIdRevoke.notes: 200 RevokeView; denylists {KEY_BROKE} durably but keeps the binding (GET still 200). Idempotent: revoking again is 200. Governance off ⇒ 409.

PostKeysIdRotate.notes: 200 RotatedKeyView (new secret shown once; old stops resolving — so {ORACLE_TOKEN_OK} is dead afterwards: run after every data-plane epoch). Idempotency keyed (actor, 'rotate:{id}:{k}'), TTL 600 s, replay 200 verbatim, in-flight 409. No 400 declared.

GetKeysIdUsage.notes: 200 KeyMeteringView for the current UTC-day bucket; governance off ⇒ 404.

GetOpenapiJson.notes: 200 the OpenAPI 3.1 document served verbatim; 1.5.5 info.version reads "1.5.4" (stale, per inventory). The document itself is the recorded artefact openapi-1.5.5.json.

DeleteOverlaySection.notes: 200 OverlayResetView {changed,...}; section enum is groups|hooks|root|plugin_versions (spec + Cond::UnknownSection). The requested `limits` is NOT a 1.5.5 overlay section ⇒ 400 invalid_request, so it is recorded as the not_found probe (expect 400, never 404). `root` is the section PutConfigSettings writes, so run this AFTER PutConfigSettings to revert it. Already-empty section ⇒ 200 changed:false. Stale If-Match 409; ephemeral (no disk config) 400.

PostPlugins.notes: ok: null — needs published plugin fixture. 201 PluginInstallView on success. `tarball_b64` required ⇒ bad_body 400; bad filename 400 Cond::InvalidFilename; untrusted upload 409 Cond::UntrustedUpload; name collision 409.

PostPluginsInspect.notes: ok: null — needs published plugin fixture. 200 PluginSchemaView; read-only scope, own rate class PluginInspect (30/min). `tarball_b64` required ⇒ bad_body 400; a non-loadable artifact is 400 Cond::NotLoadable.

PostPluginsReload.notes: 200 PluginReloadView (dlclose/dlopen cycle + swap). Oracle config has plugins disabled/no plugin dir: expect 200 with an empty reload or 400 — record whatever 1.5.5 emits. Rate class Config.

PostPluginsRollback.notes: ok: null — needs published plugin fixture. `file` required ⇒ bad_body 400. Unknown file is 404 (no path param, so not_found is null); not loadable 409; stale If-Match 409; ephemeral 400.

DeletePluginsFile.notes: ok: null — needs published plugin fixture. 204 on success; unknown file 404; invalid filename 400. No If-Match on this op.

GetPluginsFileSchema.notes: ok: null — needs published plugin fixture. 200 PluginSchemaView on success; unknown file 404.

GetPools.notes: 200 Page_PoolView with live member status inlined (`oracle-unused`); a non-boolean `detail` is 400.

GetProviders.notes: 200 Page_ProviderView: the six dialect-named providers (api_key redacted).

PostRestart.notes: 202 RestartView {restarting, supervisor_detected, note}; drains BOTH listeners and exits — the process is gone afterwards, so this is its own final epoch. Without `confirm: true` and no detected supervisor ⇒ 409 Cond::NoSupervisor; no shutdown channel ⇒ 409 NotRestartable. RestartReq is additionalProperties:false ⇒ unknown field / non-boolean 400. Rate class Config.

PostSigningKeyRotate.notes: 200 SigningKeyRotateView — rotates NOTHING in 1.5.5: reports the current kid and instructs the operator (audit action `signing_key.report`). Governance off / no signing key ⇒ 409 (Cond::NothingToRotate / NoSigningKey). Marked mutating only because it writes an audit record.

GetUsage.notes: 200 UsageView for the current UTC-day bucket {window, as_of, currency, total, by_model, by_key}; `window` (a past bucket start epoch) is optional, invalid ⇒ 400. as_of varies — normalise.
